comparison.objective: Stabilize a deformable jacket while pulling an already-started zipper to the collar and releasing it; the candidate calibrates a rigid gripper stop.
comparison.physical_skill: PR-2109 tests deformable restraint and zipper-slider tracking with possible regrasping; the candidate tests rigid precision tool engagement, coupled torque, and functional actuation.
comparison.success_condition: PR-2109 scores zipper travel, seated pin, final top position, and gripper clearance; the candidate scores locked opening angle, three-cycle repeatability, drift, retention, and clearance.
comparison.reason: Deformable garment stabilization and slider traversal do not overlap with screw-and-jam-nut calibration.
